初星きらめく 新たな夜が明ける\r\n: Hatsuboshi twinkles on a new dawn
暁星仰ぎ見て 日々がはじまる\r\n: As we gaze upon the morning star, a new day begins
我が学び舎の門はあり\r\n: The gate of our school lies before you
陽光浴びて 星の種よ 芽吹け\r\n: Basked in sunlight, let the starry seed sprout
大空に夢を 今 託してはばたけ\r\n: To the great sky, entrust your dreams and spread your wings
遥かな未来へ 憧れを響かせて\r\n: Let your aspirations echo far into the future
友と 今 高らかに歌おう\r\n: With your comrades, now sing loud and clear
ああ 若人よ 世界へ挑め\r\n: Ah, youth, go take on the world
ああ 若人よ 信じて笑え\r\n: Ah, youth, have faith and smile
